intent: Eight individually authored need/feeling tasks separate preventive advice, stated causes, relative event order and feared versus actual events without guessing from images.
picturePurpose: An original puppy/chair comparison supports behind/in-front spatial evidence only; feelings and their causes require explicit text. A coded packing action keeps prevention separate from a guaranteed future outcome.

workshop.title: 感受有依据，结果不乱猜
workshop.instruction: 带好水、辨位置、核对前后；把感受、目的和结果分清。

items.label: hungry：先游泳，后觉得饿
items.prompt: Keep the feeling and its place after the swim.
items.material: We felt hungry after the long swim.
items.reason: felt是feel的过去式，felt后用形容词hungry。after the long swim说明游泳后的感受；没有说他们吃了什么。hunger通常作名词，不能直接替换这里的hungry。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the feeling and its place after the swim.

recordSelection.title: 把感受放在正确的事件之后
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句已经说出的信息。

rows.label: After swimming → hungry
rows.text: The group felt hungry after the long swim.

rows.label: Before swimming only
rows.text: The group only felt hungry before swimming.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选After swimming → hungry；不要换成游泳前或口渴。

options.text: The group only felt hungry before swimming.
options.reason: 把after改成了before。

options.text: The group is only described as thirsty.
options.reason: hungry是饿，thirsty是渴，不能互换。

options.text: The group felt hungry after swimming for a long time.
options.reason: after说明游泳后，不是游泳前。

items.label: thirsty：带水是预防，不是已发生
items.prompt: Pack water for the stated purpose.
items.material: Take water so you do not get thirsty.
items.before: Take water so you do not get
items.reason: get thirsty表示感到口渴。Take water so ...提出带水的建议和目的；不是说已经口渴，也不保证以后绝不会渴。thirsty的比较级是thirstier，注意保留r。
items.hint: 先做带水的准备，再区分目的和结果。

wordDecision.prompt: Pack water for the stated purpose.

provision.title: 出发前，把饮用水带上
provision.hint: 示意图只表示带没带水；后来的身体感受仍需实际记录。
provision.wrong: 按建议把水带上；同时保留“预防口渴”的目的，不能改成已经口渴或永不口渴。

options.text: The listener is definitely thirsty already.
options.reason: 原句是建议和目的，没有说已经口渴。

options.text: Taking water is advised to help prevent thirst.
options.reason: so说明带水的目的，get thirsty是变得口渴。

options.text: Packing water proves the listener can never become thirsty.
options.reason: 目的不是对未来结果的保证。

items.label: angry：因为什么生气
items.prompt: Link the speaker’s anger to the broken promise.
items.material: I was angry about the broken promise.
items.reason: be angry about后接让人生气的事情；be angry with somebody常用于生某人的气。broken promise是没有兑现的承诺，不是坏掉的物品。原句没有指明是谁违背承诺。
items.hint: about后找事情，不猜是谁做的。

wordDecision.prompt: Link the speaker’s anger to the broken promise.

recordSelection.title: 保留感受和它的原因
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句已经说出的信息。

rows.label: Cause → broken promise
rows.text: A broken promise was the stated cause.

rows.label: Named person
rows.text: The sentence identifies who broke the promise.

recordSelection.hint: 感受和原因都要留；是谁违约，原句没说。
recordSelection.wrong: 选Speaker → angry和Cause → broken promise；不能补出违约者的身份。

options.text: The speaker felt angry about a promise that was broken.
options.reason: about后是生气的事情：承诺被违背。

options.text: The speaker is angry because a broken model was repaired.
options.reason: 原句是promise，不是模型被修好。

options.text: The speaker felt happy that the promise was broken.
options.reason: angry不是happy，感受被改反。

items.label: upset：模型坏时的难过
items.prompt: Keep the stated feeling when the model broke.
items.material: He felt upset when his model broke.
items.reason: felt upset中upset作形容词，表示心烦、难过。when his model broke给出当时的情境。break的过去式是broke；原句没说是谁弄坏、后来修没修好。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the stated feeling when the model broke.

recordSelection.title: 别把感受读成故意破坏
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句已经说出的信息。

rows.label: Upset when it broke
rows.text: He felt unhappy when his model broke.

rows.label: Deliberate damage
rows.text: He deliberately broke someone else’s model.

rows.label: After repair only
rows.text: The feeling only followed a completed repair.

recordSelection.hint: felt upset是感到难过；broke是坏了。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Upset when it broke；故意破坏和修好都没有写。

options.text: He deliberately broke someone else’s model.
options.reason: 这不是upset作动词，原句也没说他故意弄坏别人的模型。

options.text: He felt upset only after the model was repaired.
options.reason: when his model broke不是修好后。

options.text: He felt unhappy when his model broke.
options.reason: upset在felt后说明人的心烦或难过。

items.label: worried：担心谁，不预言结果
items.prompt: Keep the concern and its stated object.
items.material: We were worried about the injured bird.
items.reason: be worried about表示担心……；injured修饰bird，指受伤的鸟。担心是当时的感受，不能直接推出后来死亡或完全康复。
items.hint: 把担心的对象和后来结果分开。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the concern and its stated object.

recordSelection.title: 留住担心，不补写结局
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句已经说出的信息。

rows.label: Concern about the bird
rows.text: The group was worried about an injured bird.

rows.label: Full recovery
rows.text: The bird had definitely recovered fully.

recordSelection.hint: 原句只报告担心和受伤，没有后续结局。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Concern about the bird；死亡和康复都没有根据。

options.text: The sentence proves the bird later died.
options.reason: 担心不证明后来死亡。

options.text: The group was concerned about an injured bird.
options.reason: worried about说明担心的对象，受伤的鸟。

options.text: The sentence guarantees the bird had fully recovered.
options.reason: 原句没说已经康复。

items.label: nervous：发言前的紧张
items.prompt: Place the nervous feeling before the school speech.
items.material: I felt nervous before speaking to the whole school.
items.after: before speaking to the whole school.
items.reason: before speaking中before后用doing，表示发言前。nervous是紧张，不等于害怕所有危险，也不能证明实际表现不好。to the whole school指面向全校的人发言。
items.hint: 先放对before，再分开感受和表现。

wordDecision.prompt: Place the nervous feeling before the school speech.

recordSelection.title: 发言前紧张，不等于结果失败
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句已经说出的信息。

rows.label: Before the speech
rows.text: The speaker felt nervous before speaking.

rows.label: Only after finishing
rows.text: The feeling only began after the speech.

recordSelection.hint: 时间在发言前，结果还不能从这句判断。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Before the speech；发言后的时间和失败结果都是改写。

options.text: The speaker felt nervous before addressing the whole school.
options.reason: before speaking给出发言前的感受。

options.text: The speaker only felt nervous after finishing the speech.
options.reason: before不是after。

options.text: The sentence proves the speech was a failure.
options.reason: 紧张不证明发言失败，原句没给结果。

items.label: afraid：怕滑倒，不等于已滑倒
items.prompt: Keep the feared possibility on the wet steps.
items.material: She is afraid of slipping on the wet steps.
items.after: of slipping on the wet steps.
items.reason: be afraid of doing表示害怕做某事或某事发生；slipping是slip的-ing形式，要双写p。wet steps是湿台阶，不是湿的脚步。这里只说她担心滑倒，不能补成已经摔倒。
items.hint: of后用slipping；把担心与已经发生分开。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the feared possibility on the wet steps.

recordSelection.title: 只保留害怕发生的事
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句已经说出的信息。

rows.label: Fear of slipping
rows.text: She is afraid she might slip on the wet steps.

rows.label: Wants to slip
rows.text: She wants to slip on the steps.

recordSelection.hint: 可能发生的担心，不是已完成的事件。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Fear of slipping；already fallen和wants都改了意思。

options.text: The sentence proves she has already fallen.
options.reason: 害怕不证明已经摔倒。

options.text: She wants to slip on the wet steps.
options.reason: 害怕不是想要发生。

options.text: She fears slipping on steps that are wet.
options.reason: afraid of slipping说害怕可能滑倒。

items.label: scared：按文字找椅子后的小狗
items.prompt: The record says the scared puppy hid behind the chair. Tap the matching view.
items.material: The scared puppy hid behind the chair.
items.reason: scared修饰puppy，说明小狗感到害怕；scary可描述令人害怕的事物。hid是hide的过去式。behind是后面，与in front of相反；图片只辨位置，不能靠表情证明害怕的原因。

wordDecision.prompt: The record says the scared puppy hid behind the chair. Tap the matching view.

art.alt: 两个对照画面：左图小狗在椅子后，身体被椅子部分挡住；右图小狗在椅子前，身体清楚可见。

evidence.caption: A中椅子挡住小狗的一部分，符合behind。害怕由文字scared说明，不靠表情猜。
B中小狗在椅子前，符合in front of，不是behind。

options.text: B: the puppy is in front of the chair.
options.reason: 右图小狗在椅子前，不能表示behind。

options.text: A: the puppy is behind the chair.
options.reason: 左图小狗的身体被椅子部分挡住；害怕来自文字scared。

transfer.stem: Which club notes preserve the advice, timing and actual event?
transfer.passage:
OUTDOOR CLUB NOTES
Before we left, our leader said, “Take water so you do not get thirsty.” This was advice about preparation, not a report that we were already thirsty.
At the hall I felt nervous before speaking to the whole club, but my talk went well. After a long swim, we felt hungry.
Near the path, Lan was afraid of slipping on wet steps. She walked carefully and did not fall. We were worried about an injured bird, but we had no news about what happened to it later.
Back at school, a scared puppy hid behind a chair. The written report says it was scared; its position in a picture would not tell us the cause of that feeling.

options.text: Taking water was preventive advice; the nervous feeling came before the talk; Lan feared slipping but did not fall.
Taking water proves nobody could ever get thirsty; the nervous feeling came before the talk; Lan feared slipping but did not fall.
Taking water was preventive advice; the nervous feeling came only after the talk; Lan feared slipping but did not fall.
Taking water was preventive advice; the nervous feeling came before the talk; Lan had already fallen on the steps.

answer.display: Taking water was preventive advice; the nervous feeling came before the talk; Lan feared slipping but did not fall.

explanation.strategy: 先分目的和保证，再核对before，最后分害怕发生和实际发生。

steps.text: 带水是预防口渴的建议；紧张发生在发言前，发言本身顺利。
steps.reason: advice about preparation限定建议；before speaking定位感受。

steps.text: 她担心滑倒，但记录明确说did not fall，不能写成已经摔倒。
steps.reason: afraid of说明害怕的可能；did not fall说明实际结果。

distractors.reason: 预防建议不是绝不会口渴的保证。
原文明确没摔倒，不能把担心改成已经发生。

explanation.pitfall: 把建议说成保证，把before读成after，或把害怕的事写成已经发生。

visual.title: 目的、时间、实际结果
visual.caption: 关系来自这份原创俱乐部记录，不给身体状态或事件编结局。

explanation.transfer: 如果一个人发言前紧张但讲得很好，能把nervous直接改写成failed吗？带了水能证明永远不会渴吗？
